title: The Four Lepers and the Aramean Camp
description: During the famine in Samaria, four lepers at the city gate decide to go over to the Aramean camp. The Lord has made the enemy hear the sound of a great army, so the Arameans have fled and left everything behind. The lepers eat and gather plunder, but realize they must report it to the king. The people plunder the camp, and a fine measure of flour is sold for one shekel, just as Elisha had predicted. The officer who doubted the prophecy was trampled to death at the gate.
